description: This file defines the EventScheduler class within the com.example.android.common.midi package. It manages scheduling and processing of 'SchedulableEvent' objects, storing them in a timestamped buffer, supporting thread-safe adding, removing, and fetching of events, including waiting for upcoming events. It includes nested classes for event representation and event queues, along with methods to manage event pooling for reuse.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduled events in a timestamped, thread-safe buffer with support for event addition, removal, and waiting for upcoming events.

classes.name: EventScheduler.SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Represents an individual schedulable event with a timestamp, capable of being linked in a list.

classes.name: EventScheduler.FastEventQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe linked list of events, supporting addition and removal of events in order.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the reusable event pool, leaving at least one in pool.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse, avoiding unbounded memory growth.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event to the scheduler, maintaining order and notifying if earlier than existing events.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Checks and retrieves the next event ready for processing based on current time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent
methods.description: Blocks until the next scheduled event is ready to be processed, using system nano time.

methods.name: removeNextEventLocked
methods.description: Removes and returns the next event from the buffer within a synchronized context.
